note: Generated by tools/make_role_map.py from the crimson preset's palette and token values and the style index. Every entry is UNVERIFIED until Session 2 has looked at a generated theme in the game.

entries.decision: S4 amendment, owner decision 2 (2026-11-15): the defender badge pair blocks, so the theme sets the badge label
entries.why: the game's own label colour reads at 4.41 to 1 on its fill (minimum 4.5); the theme's primary text replaces it, and the fill keeps the game's teal so positions keep their colours. NOT ANCHORED in Crimson: Crimson sets this label to its teal Light (#8AD9CD), which is on none of the three ramps, so the reproduction test does not cover this entry. VISIBILITY UNKNOWN: no style rule of this build uses this token (reach 0) and no token refers to it; whether it paints the badge (game code may read it while running) is for Session 2 to observe with fm_get_styles; if it does not, the entry comes out.
